method.arena: engine-rs (Polytopia 2.17.3 rules), 14x14 classic maps, 1v1; seat-paired: every map is played twice with the seats swapped; raw policies with sampled actions, no search; maps unseen in training
method.round_cap: 200 rounds, a harness limit (not a game rule). score: a capped game counts for the side ahead on score; elimination_only_score: a capped game counts as a draw
method.interval: 99% map-clustered (the arena standard error with both seat swaps of a map in one cluster, x 2.5758)
method.preregistration: each panel (matches, seeds, decision rules) was frozen, with the SHA-256 of its JSON, before the candidate was evaluated
method.checkpoint_names: plato-u<N> = the Plato training run at update N; dollar labels are cumulative training+evaluation spend when it was saved

opponents.hero1 (weights/hero-1v1): 4x128 CNN (1.97M params), strongest earlier 1v1 bot on the game rules; byte-identical to weights/hero-1v1/final.npz (sha256 e6f4e197...)
opponents.champion (weights/champion): 2x64 CNN, the site bot; raw policy here (no search); byte-identical to weights/champion/final.npz (sha256 90618f5a...)
opponents.CNN control final ($97): hero-1v1 architecture (4x128 normalized-v2) trained from scratch with the same recipe and a matched $100 budget, run alongside stage 1 as a control; not released
opponents.Cloak exploiter (not released): the CNN control fine-tuned for 1 h against plato-u23270 only; learned a Cloak/Dagger infiltration line that beat u23270 .87
opponents.x3d peace exploiter (not released): a from-scratch 4x128 exploiter trained against plato-u23270; it only ever won through peace treaties

checks.check: Equal-dollar crossover: Plato run vs the CNN control at $25 each

rows.opponent: 1-GPU run of the same architecture, u500 (not released)
